description: Produces visual-effect assets: particle sheets, trails, impact flashes, shader-driven effects. Follows the art bible. Writes files to the asset staging area; does not wire them into the game.
when_to_use: the request is to produce effects rather than static art
an effect on the checklist has to be made
avoid_when: the effect needs engine-side scripting rather than an asset
the files exist and only need importing
outputs: vfx assets in the staging area
